capabilities: Float the active note in an always-on-top panel
Keep several floated notes as reorderable tabs
Edit tabs in Live Preview, Source or read-only View
Drag, resize, hide and reopen the panel across Spaces and displays
Set panel opacity and debug logging in settings
extras: macOS only: on Windows and Linux the commands show a notice and do nothing. Relies on non-public Obsidian and Electron internals that updates can break; troubleshooting is via a debug log setting. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: Since macOS 10.14 an ordinary window cannot float over another app's full-screen Space, and Obsidian's popout windows are ordinary windows whose options a plugin cannot change, so the author built a separate panel-type window with its own editor.
problem: Obsidian's popout windows are ordinary windows, so a note cannot be kept on top of other apps, full-screen Spaces, or across displays while you work elsewhere.

relations.evidence: like Tot's overlay but for a note in your vault

summary: macOS-only plugin that floats the current note in a small always-on-top panel that stays visible across Spaces, full-screen apps and displays.
